questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Reds are Emeralds.

No Emeralds are Magentas.

All Magentas are Greens.

Conclusion (I): Some Magentas are Emeralds

Conclusion (II): Some Emeralds are Greens
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

Some Reds are Emeralds.

No Emeralds are Magentas.

All Magentas are Greens.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9e7339ef9c8b77c638d62494854dfb25ebba74ff363a65a99dd27952ea0bdb9.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Magentas are Emeralds. - Does not follow (Because, no Emeralds are Magentas, so no Magentas and Emeralds.)

(II) Some Emeralds are Greens. - Does not follow (There is no definite relation between Emeralds and Greens, it can be possible but it is not definite.)

Thus, neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(5, 31, 6)

(3, 16, 5)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(a, b, c) → (a × c) + 1 = b

(5 × 6) + 1 = 30 + 1 = 31

(3 × 5) + 1 = 15 + 1 = 16

Let's check each option:

 
• (6, 13, 2) → (6 × 2) + 1 = 12 + 1 = 13
 
• (4, 7, 2) → (4 × 2) + 1 = 8 + 1 = 9 ≠ 7
 
• (1, 6, 4) → (1 × 4) + 1 = 4 + 1 = 5 ≠ 6
 
• (3, 2, 7) → (3 × 7) + 1 = 21 + 1 = 22 ≠ 2

Thus, (6, 13, 2) is the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the given sets.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

 139 div 7 + 341 times 11 - 41 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b8562d51eaa1bb2bf326e060e5e4c407f505f3ac89aefd9915fb195d0005ae9.png] 

Given equation: 139 ÷ 7 + 341 × 11 - 41 = ?

If ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged, then the equation becomes:

⇒ 139 × 7 − __**341 ÷ 11**__ + 41 = ?
⇒ __**139 × 7**__ − 31 + 41 = ?
⇒ __**973**__ − 31 __**+ 41**__ = ?
⇒ __**1014 − 31**__ = ?
⇒ 983 = ?

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
